title: PlayerHeadshotRecord
description: Where one canonical player's public portrait lives, keyed once by player_id rather than duplicated across every tier and arbitrage row. DECORATION ONLY: no field here may enter a projection, a VORP, a fair rank, a tier or an arbitrage score, and nothing here is a measurement of the player (ADR-087). `provider_player_id` is the crosswalk id the identity registry already holds — for ESPN that is `espn_id`, the primary market identity bridge of ADR-019 — so this artifact mints no new identity and resolves no name. `image_url` is the resolved address the browser will request; it is published rather than assembled in the browser so the one host the page may reach is a validated property of the build, not a string in a bundle.

provider.description: The portrait provider. An enum rather than a free string: adding one is a rights decision (docs/SECURITY_LICENSE.md section 8), not a data change.

provider_player_id.description: The provider's own athlete id, taken from the canonical crosswalk. Never a name and never a fuzzy match.

image_url.description: The exact address the browser requests. The pattern pins the host, so a build that tried to point the page at a different origin fails validation rather than shipping.
